text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Brayden, I know another game that didn't go your way, but that fourth quarter you guys scored 44 points. You really took over in the third quarter. What felt different offensively for this group in the second half?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: Second half, I think we were just flowing. We were getting more stops. First half, they made a lot of threes. They did a good job. But yeah, second half was more of a flow and then honestly I had a more of an aggressive mindset, just trying to get in the paint and make a play.

text_blocks.text: When Giannis is collapsing the paint, how was it just not shifting, rotating quick enough, or was he able to find outlets that you didn't anticipate?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
